incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: PD-123456 — inference-service (eu-west-1) — high latency + 5xx spike :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Trigger details: avg p50 latency 1.2s -> 6.8s, 500 rate 12% over 3m. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/inference/high-latency
alex: ACK — taking this. I'll check pods, autoscaler, and KV cache.
maya: adding customer signal: two hosted customers reported timeouts (~60s). Notified CSMs.
incidentbot: PagerDuty acknowledged by alex at 2025-11-02T03:41:45Z
alex: quick check: one worker node showing repeated OOM kills, pod restarts every ~40s. Logs show `kvcache: failed to allocate` right before crash.
kyle: @alex I'm the on-call SRE, ping me when you want a hand. If autoscaler didn't fire we may need manual scale and route traffic to dedicated fallback.
alex: trying a manual scale to 6 replicas and bumping node group. Running:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-svc --replicas=6
gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-eu-1 --size=8
```
maya: ETA to customer notice update? CSMs want an ETA.
alex: give me 6m to verify replica health then I'll send an update.
incidentbot: Escalation policy: if not acknowledged by senior within 10m, auto-escalate. (already acknowledged)
kyle: looking at autoscaler metrics — there was a config mismatch (target CPU=80% but metric reported as request-based). Creating a temporary patch to use queue length trigger.
alex: patched HPA to use custom-metrics, started draining problematic node. New replicas are coming up, KV cache warmup not yet hit.
maya: I'll tell CSMs we're mitigating and expect service normalization in ~10m.
alex: warmup script started: `curl -s https://warmup.internal/infer?warm=true` on new pods to populate KV cache.
kyle: also routing rule applied: traffic split 70/30 to warm pool to reduce tail latency.
alex: observing 5xx drop to 1.8% over last 2m, p95 latency down to 900ms. Continuing to monitor.
maya: CSMs informed, flagged high-priority customers for follow-up.
alex: mitigation holding. I'll keep monitoring for 30m then close.
incidentbot: PagerDuty note added: mitigated by manual scaling + KV warmup script; awaiting stable metrics before resolving.
alex: mark as RESOLVED — traffic normal at 23:02 UTC, 5xx <0.5%. Follow-up: file a postmortem to fix autoscaler trigger and add KV warmstart on scale events.
incidentbot: Page resolved by alex at 2025-11-02T03:57:58Z
